subject.title: [Bug]: WeChat channel session permanently corrupted after ingesting binary file attachments

question: Should this issue stay open as distinct WeChat binary-ingestion evidence while the overlapping placeholder and reply-session fixes land, or should maintainers fold it into one canonical tracker now?
rationale: The report spans external WeChat plugin media handling, core reply-session state, and provider tool-result projection, so automation cannot safely choose the ownership boundary or closure target without maintainer scoping.

options.title: Keep Distinct WeChat Evidence
options.body: Leave this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100281 and the session/package work are released or validated against the WeChat binary-attachment path.

options.title: Fold Into Placeholder Tracker
options.body: Close or retarget this to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99881 if maintainers decide the WeChat trigger is only another non-canonical image/tool-output placeholder manifestation.

options.title: Route To Plugin Owner
options.body: Move the remaining work to the external WeChat plugin if maintainers confirm core preserves text and session invariants after the related fixes land.

recommendation.title: Keep Distinct WeChat Evidence
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100281 and the session/package work are released or validated against the WeChat binary-attachment path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest evidence-backed routing signal across the provider helper refactor and WeChat external-plugin boundary docs, with session and placeholder contributors as implementation owners.
